title: User function body inlined at synth — Tier 4.3 B1 minimum case
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Concurrent assign `y <= and2(a, b);` where `and2` is a user-declared function whose body is `return x and z`. Runtime already correct via DeferredUserFunction. Tier 4.3 B1 inlines the function body at synth time so the schematic shows a real AND cell instead of an opaque UserFunction-{name} constant. Bench passes on VCD equality regardless of which synth path takes hold; the inlining is verified separately via the schematic viewer / audit-synth.
